system_under_test: Agent Merge Gate Phase-3 deterministic vertical slice
selection_rule: Defect mutations must be plausibly outside the assertions of the pre-existing ordinary pytest suite. This is verified again by actually running ordinary CI on each candidate; any candidate ordinary CI rejects is ineligible for the incremental-value subset.

rules.system_outcome_source: actual Agent Merge Gate evidence bundle only

cases.invariant: Transfer authorization, positive amount, overdraft prevention and transaction atomicity satisfy the explicit task requirements.
Debit and credit must be atomic: if credit fails after debit, the source balance must be restored.
cases.mutation: Remove transaction rollback semantics while leaving the successful transfer path and existing authorization/amount/overdraft behavior unchanged.
cases.expected_observable_failure: When repo.credit raises after debit, source balance remains reduced instead of being restored.

cases.invariant: At most three requests per user are allowed in any rolling ten-second window.
A request exactly nine seconds after the earliest accepted request is still inside the ten-second rolling window.
cases.mutation: Expire the oldest request one second too early at the lower rolling-window boundary while preserving the existing tested 0/1/2/3 and 0/5/9/11 examples.
cases.expected_observable_failure: After accepted requests at t=0,1,2, a request at t=9 is incorrectly accepted instead of blocked.

cases.invariant: Token uses a keyed hash over user_id and issued_at, remains URL-safe and does not expose the supplied secret key.
The supplied secret key must not be exposed in the returned token.
cases.mutation: Append a URL-safe encoding of the supplied secret key to the otherwise valid HMAC token, preserving determinism, input sensitivity and URL-safe characters checked by the existing tests.
cases.expected_observable_failure: The returned reset token contains a reversible encoding of secret_key.

constraints: Primary incremental-value cases must survive ordinary CI on the exact candidate.
A VETO counts as DETECTED only when blocking evidence is causally linked to the frozen seeded defect.
